correctness.rationale: The accelerated degree thresholds are strictly increasing and superadditive, so they define finite-dimensional filtrations. Exact bounds on successive quotient dimensions give the prescribed entropy, while k[x] retains intrinsic linear growth and GK dimension one. The universal-quantifier repair follows from comparison with a finite generating space and submultiplicativity of standard-filtration dimensions.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The current v1 source states the unrestricted finite-dimensional-filtration claims corrected here. The 2024 defining paper establishes linear reindexing dependence and suggests, but does not prove, zero-entropy invariance. Targeted searches did not locate the full [0,infinity] spectrum on k[x], this explicit correction, or the every-filtration characterization. Classical filtered-GK hypotheses are treated as prior art.

value.rationale: A one-variable commutative example invalidates several central growth-detection statements in a current preprint, explains the missing associated-graded finiteness condition, realizes every possible entropy value on one polynomial algebra, and supplies a sharp corrected growth criterion.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, formal verification, or a guarantee of first discovery.
